Situation Report — Iran–Israel–US (latest)

  • Active military action: IDF drones in Zaytoun (east Gaza) reportedly placing explosives on buildings for later detonation.
  • Gaza — Humanitarian: IDF and COGAT continue winter preparations and entry of winter supplies. Medical services and sanitation being strengthened. Gaza risks losing power and healthcare with rainfall. A six-year-old Gaza burn victim is caught in a dispute over medical aid.
  • Diplomacy & threats: Iran threatens an “unlimited response” over the Strait of Hormuz after a US attack. Iran told the IAEA monitoring cannot proceed while it is under threat.
  • Regional military moves: Turkey proposes deploying troops to southern Lebanon.
  • Economic impact: Brent crude rose to $96 amid renewed tensions.
  • Threat trend: Rising — multiple threats and military actions reported across the region.
  • 🟢 Good News: Continued entry of winter supplies and coordinated humanitarian efforts by IDF, COGAT, the UN and partners.

Situation report — last 6 hours

  • Active attacks / incidents
    • IRGC claims it destroyed a U.S. radar site in Bahrain with suicide drones, saying this was in response to strikes on Sirik. (IRGC / AP / Middle_East_Spectator)
    • An LNG carrier/tanker struck a mine in the Strait of Hormuz. (TASS / Reuters / IRGC Navy)
    • Iran warns of an \"unlimited response\" over the Strait of Hormuz after U.S. strikes. (Al Jazeera)

  • Gaza

    • IDF reports ongoing humanitarian and winter preparations: entry of winter supplies, strengthened medical and sanitation services coordinated with COGAT, international organizations and donors. (IDF / idfofficial)
    • Reports of Israeli drones placing explosives on buildings in the Zaytoun neighborhood of Gaza City. (AbuAliExpress)
    • Israeli strike near midnight in Khan Yunis killed two Gaza residents; casualty toll from a prior hospital strike in Khan Yunis increased. A six-year-old Gaza burn victim is at the center of a medical-aid dispute. (AbuAliExpress / Times of Israel)

  • Maritime & military cooperation

    • Commander of the U.S. Fifth Fleet concluded a visit to Israel. Israel and the U.S. say maritime partnership is being strengthened. (IDF / idfofficial)
    • Oil: Brent crude rose to about $96 amid renewed tensions. (AbuAliExpress)

  • Nuclear monitoring / diplomacy

    • IAEA reports growing concern about an Iranian enrichment plant and says it has not received information or access to Iranian facilities. Iran told the UN nuclear agency monitoring cannot proceed while it is \"under threat.\" (Reuters / AP / liveuamap)

  • Regional moves

    • Turkey proposes deploying troops in southern Lebanon. (Maariv)
    • Houthi forces report advances on Yemen's southern coast and capture of several positions; Yemeni government forces say they repelled a Houthi attack at Al-Aqrud. (CIG_telegram / liveuamap)

  • Domestic / political

    • U.S. political rhetoric on Iran intensified (multiple Trump statements reported). (Times of Israel / AbuAliExpress)

  • Threat trend

    • Escalating — multiple maritime incidents, IRGC strikes/claims, Iranian threats, and increased U.S.-Israel maritime coordination in the last six hours.

  • 🟢 Good News

    • IDF-coordinated entry of winter supplies and strengthening of Gaza medical/sanitation capacity. U.S. Fifth Fleet visit signals closer operational ties for maritime defense.

  • Gaza: IDF airstrikes continued overnight. Two Palestinians were killed in a strike on a tent in Khan Younis. Local reports allege Israeli drones placed explosives on buildings in the Zaytoun neighborhood. Rain raises risk to Gaza power and healthcare access.
  • Levant / Lebanon: Low-altitude Israeli drone flights reported over Beirut. Turkey has offered to deploy troops in southern Lebanon.
  • U.S.–Israel military ties: Commander of the U.S. Fifth Fleet visited Israel; Israel reports strengthened maritime partnership.
  • IAEA / Nuclear monitoring: Iran told the UN nuclear agency monitoring cannot proceed. IAEA expresses growing concern and lack of access/info on Iranian facilities.
  • Regional fighting: Houthi/Ansarullah offensive continues in Yemen with reported captures and ongoing counterattacks.
  • Economic: Brent crude price cited near $96 amid renewed tension.
  • Threat trend: Escalating — maritime incidents and reciprocal strikes between Iran and U.S. forces reported in the last 24 hours.
  • Insufficient verified detail to assess an immediate direct threat to Israel’s territory beyond reported drone flights over Beirut and continued Gaza strikes.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF and COGAT continue winter preparations and humanitarian entries into Gaza; U.S. naval visit signals continued military support.

  • Strikes / attacks reported:

    • IAEA reports growing concern about an Iranian enrichment plant and says it has not received information or access to Iranian facilities.

  • Regional dynamics
    • Turkey proposes deploying troops in southern Lebanon.
    • Yemeni government forces say they repelled a large-scale Houthi attack in Taiz; Houthis reported advances elsewhere.
    • U.S.–Iran–Gulf exchanges marked by reciprocal strikes, claims and maritime incidents.
  • Domestic / political messaging
    • U.S. political leaders publicly intensifying rhetoric toward Iran (multiple reports referencing Trump interviews/statements).
  • Threat trend: Escalating — multiple strikes, maritime incidents, and reciprocal claims across the region.
  • 🟢 Good News:
    • IDF/COGAT report continued entry of winter supplies and coordination with international agencies.
    • U.S.–Israel naval ties visibly reinforced by the U.S. Fifth Fleet visit.
    • Yemeni government forces reported repelling a major Houthi attack in Taiz.
